title: A Aa
desc: Anasuya is the daughter of Mahalakshmi, a rich and strict businesswoman. Her life takes a turn for the better when her father sends her to a village to visit her aunt.

title: Puthiyamugham
desc: An honest fresher faces chaos in his life by some boys as he joined collge. After years of sufferings, he finally decides to take on them.

title: Engeyum Kadhal
desc: Kayal, a cellist in Paris, falls in love with Kamal at first sight and saves him from possible death. However, she gets disheartened when she learns that he does not reciprocate her feelings.

title: Puriyaadha Pudhir
desc: Escaped convict Raghu unknowingly seeks refuge in his college friend Geetha's home. Complications arise swiftly when he makes a shocking discovery of a hidden corpse.

title: Thirumalai
desc: A simple mechanic falls in love with a young girl. However, her father, who owns a television channel, opposes their relationship and enlists the help of a man to separate them.
